title: grod rules
description: One file, every platform. Each rule removes one distraction; a missing platform section means the rule does nothing there.

why.description: Shown when the rule fires. Say what stays usable.

youtubeChannels.description: YouTube channels whose videos disappear everywhere: feeds, search, recommendations; their watch and channel pages are blocked. Applied on the web and in the YouTube Android app.

hosts.description: Hostnames. A host also matches its subdomains (youtube.com matches m.youtube.com).

hide.description: Plain CSS selectors (no uBlock extensions) hidden with display:none. Videos inside are paused.

redirect.description: Applied first. Path+query regex (JS syntax) to a replacement using $1..$9.

block.description: Path regexes (JS syntax) checked after redirect. A match shows the grod blocked page. Use "^/" to block the whole host.

matcher.description: Every field present must match one accessibility node. viewId is the id without the package prefix. text and desc are exact, descContains is a substring; all case-insensitive.

feed.description: Any matcher found on screen means the user is inside the feed; grod runs the action. Missing or empty: the whole app is the feed.

exempt.description: Any matcher found on screen holds the action (e.g. one reel opened from a DM) until the user scrolls the feed.

cover.description: Nodes covered with an opaque overlay that swallows taps (e.g. the Reels tab button).

mask.description: Nodes hidden under an opaque overlay that lets touches through, for large areas such as feed thumbnails: the page still scrolls and a tap still reaches the app.

action.description: back: press Back, then Home if still in the feed. home: go straight to the launcher; use when the whole app is the feed.

quitApps.description: Bundle ids quit when they launch or come to the front. Only for apps that are all feed.

name.description: Display name exactly as YouTube shows it; the Android app matches on it.

handle.description: Channel handle with @, as in youtube.com/@handle; the web matches on it.

id.description: Channel id, for pages that link /channel/<id> instead of the handle.
